question: Is it sports-science acceptable that, while the clinical route is pending, THRESHOLD quality runs stay in the plan in force, where FREEZE-2 had proposed their withdrawal? Is the deferral bounded?

reasons: Kept is not prescribed. While the route is pending the decision is CLINICAL_HUMAN_REQUIRED, plan validity REQUIRES_RECONCILIATION, and every later review carrying the state stays CLINICAL with no proposal. The runtime authorizes no session at all, THRESHOLD, easy or strength, until the human route resolves.

The intensity question after an illness or injury signal is the dependent judgment SSCTR-05 and G04 reserve to a qualified human. Choosing 'easy instead of threshold' in answer to a 'Flu illness' report is not a safe default the agent may take: it is a nonclinical return recipe. The withdrawal disclosure itself says 'the harder session leaves the plan and easy running continues'.

FREEZE-2 was not the safer behaviour despite the lower intensity. It offered that easy-running plan with a bookkeeping question and dropped the clinical dependency (B: the next review is KEEP; D: R7-A's question with pending ASK), so after flu or pain the athlete would keep running with no referral. That is the dose-instead-of-referral pattern SSCTR-05 forbids. Dropping the disclosure on the clinical route is correct for the same reason.

Clinical-screen-first (B0-C06 condition 8, D08) and QE-R7B1-01 make the clinical route the decision, and withFactualReplan makes it propose nothing; R7-B.2 applies them, and the predecessor already behaves exactly so for the same facts on the handler's own route (controls).
answer.bounded: YES for the graduation source: the withdrawal is state-derived, so the first review admitted without a pending clinical dependency re-derives it, and the resulting plan equals FREEZE-2's applied withdrawal exactly (B, B2w3, D); with the state carried it stays CLINICAL. What is not bounded by the runtime is execution of program rows between an external resolution (or a consumer ignoring the pending state) and that first admitted review: B3 shows a THRESHOLD session can fall inside that window. This window is pre-existing (identical on both runtimes for the handler's own route) and is a consumer and resolution-input matter (SSCTR-R7B2-02), recorded as SSCTR-R7B2-03 with condition C4.
answer.contrast: Unlike the factual source (SSCTR-R7B2-01, QR7B2-02), where the current week's rows are never re-derived mid-week, the graduation source is picked up at the next admitted review.

findings.title: Quality sessions a recorded correction has disqualified stay in the plan in force during a pending clinical dependency, and until the first admitted review after it
findings.statement: On a clinical route that carries a graduation-disqualifying correction, the plan in force keeps the THRESHOLD sessions (9-10 in the probes) that the correction withdraws. The runtime authorizes none of them while the dependency is carried and withdraws them at the first review admitted without it; but its output gives a consumer no marker that those rows are already invalidated, and a session can fall between an external resolution and that review (B3: the next day).
findings.origin: Pre-existing: the handler's own clinical route with the same correction behaves identically on R7B1-FREEZE-2 and R7-B.2 (B-ctl, B2w3-ctl, B3-ctl, D-ctl). B.2 extends its reach to the report-identity and late-evidence exits (QR7B2-01), where FREEZE-2 instead gave a withdrawal with the clinical signal dropped.
findings.why_not_blocking: R7-B.2's decision is the required one; the exposure needs a consumer to present unauthorized rows, or a resolution outside the runtime, and the alternative (FREEZE-2) prescribes running after an illness report with no referral. Contract §10: pre-existing, not a bypass of the same invariant.
findings.not_a_U5_item: No runtime change in B.2 can close it without attaching a dose or disclosure to a clinical route (forbidden) or defining the resolution input (SSCTR-R7B2-02, outside B.2).
findings.owner: Next runtime mission (Engineering: output and resolution-input contract), with Product/UX (how a pending clinical dependency is presented) and SSCTR
findings.next_action: Make the invalidated rows and the pending dependency unambiguous to a consumer, and make the first decision after a documented human resolution an admitted review, before any session is presented.

conditions.C4: Before any use beyond the offline synthetic reference: (a) while CLINICAL_HUMAN_REQUIRED is pending, no program session, and in particular no quality or intensity session, is presented as current or prescribed; (b) after a documented human resolution (SSCTR-R7B2-02), an admitted review re-derives the canonical factual state, including any graduation withdrawal, before any session is presented. No clinical keyword, flag, threshold or clearance path is implied.
